entities.name: Carolingian Renaissance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Carolingian Renaissance, a transformative movement in France (751–843). Emerged from Treaty of Verdun and Clovis I baptised as a Catholic Christian. Catalyzed Charlemagne crowned Emperor by Pope Leo III and Treaty of Verdun divides the Carolingian Empire.
